summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle script that runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip` for the installer's platform, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string-array deobfuscator, hex-named identifiers, large encoded constant pool) unrelated to any date-picker functionality. Executing bundled code via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime evades Node-only static analysis. The package is published under the `@ornikar` scope with a description declaring itself a `fork of Kiarash-Z`, and all README links point to the unrelated upstream `Kiarash-Z/react-modern-calendar-datepicker` — the scoped-fork framing serves as delivery cover for the dropper and payload, which are the only novel content over upstream.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
